instruction: Run `C:\\Users\\User\\Desktop\\noninv_amp.cir` in native PSpice. Save the native simulator output as `C:\\Users\\User\\Desktop\\noninv_amp.out`, then inspect the stepped 1 kHz gain results in that `.out` and write `C:\\Users\\User\\Desktop\\result.json`. The JSON must contain `Rf_found`, `Av_dB`, and `Rg`, where `Rf_found` is the smallest stepped `RF_VAL` whose native measured gain reaches at least 20 dB.
source: PSpice native parametric gain sweep using stepped measurement artifacts
